items.exampleEn: The parade was canceled because of the heavy rain.
We need one more rehearsal before the wedding.
items.exampleZh: 婚禮前我們還需要再排練一次。

items.exampleEn: The park is used for recreation by people of all ages.
items.exampleZh: 這座公園供各年齡層的人休閒使用。

items.exampleEn: He was nervous before his first audition for a TV show.
items.exampleZh: 他第一次參加電視節目試鏡前很緊張。

items.exampleEn: The cast of the movie includes several famous actors.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的演員陣容包括好幾位知名演員。

items.exampleEn: The new phone will be exhibited at the technology fair in June.
items.exampleZh: 這款新手機將在六月的科技展上展出。

items.exampleEn: Thousands of birds flying together made a great spectacle in the sky.
items.exampleZh: 數千隻鳥一起飛翔，在天空形成壯觀的景象。

items.exampleEn: The book is both entertaining and educational.
items.exampleZh: 這本書既有趣又有教育意義。

items.exampleEn: Students often rent suits and dresses for the prom.
items.exampleZh: 學生常常租西裝和禮服去參加畢業舞會。

items.exampleEn: Many young people dream of a career in showbiz.
items.exampleZh: 很多年輕人夢想在演藝圈發展。

items.sentenceEn: A rare golden car will be exhibited at the station for one week.
items.sentenceZh: 一輛罕見的金色汽車將在車站展出一週。

items.audioEn: The final rehearsal starts at six, so please arrive at the theater by half past five.
items.audioZh: 最後一次彩排六點開始，所以請在五點半前到劇院。
items.questionZh: 說話者要大家幾點前到劇院？

items.sentenceEn: The whole town came out to watch the New Year parade.
items.sentenceZh: 全鎮的人都出來看新年遊行。

items.sentenceEn: She was cast as the queen in the school play.
items.sentenceZh: 她被選中在學校話劇裡飾演皇后。

items.stemEn: Only three dancers passed the ____ and joined the company.
items.stemZh: 只有三位舞者通過試鏡，加入了舞團。

items.stemEn: The speaker was so ____ that nobody looked at their phones for an hour.
items.stemZh: 那位講者非常有趣，一個小時都沒有人看手機。

items.passageEn: Our town's spring festival is the biggest event of the year. It begins with a colorful parade, and the route goes through the old market. This year, a famous actor from the world of showbiz led the parade. At the town hall, local artists exhibited paintings of the river, and at night there was a fireworks spectacle over the lake. The high school students also performed a musical. They held auditions in January, and the cast practiced every weekend. During the final rehearsal, the lead singer lost her voice, but she got better just in time. For many teenagers, the festival is even more exciting than their prom. This year, the town also opened a new recreation center for families.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的春季節慶是一年中最大的活動。節慶以一場繽紛的遊行開場，遊行路線會經過老市場。今年，一位演藝圈的知名演員帶領遊行。在市政廳，當地藝術家展出了河景畫作，晚上湖面上還有盛大的煙火表演。高中生也演出了一齣音樂劇。他們在一月舉辦試演，全體演員每個週末都在練習。最後一次彩排時，主唱失聲了，不過她及時恢復。對許多青少年來說，這個節慶甚至比畢業舞會還令人興奮。今年，鎮上還開了一間新的家庭休閒中心。

options: 鎮長和高中樂隊的所有學生
一位演藝圈的知名演員

questions.questionZh: 最後一次彩排時發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 她和最好的朋友一起去參加了畢業舞會。
referenceEn: She went to the prom with her best friend.
She and her best friend went to the prom together.
rubricZh: 「畢業舞會」可寫，例如 the prom、the graduation dance 等
時態合理（例如 went 等）

items.promptZh: 我爸爸休閒時喜歡去釣魚。
referenceEn: For recreation, my dad likes to go fishing.
My dad enjoys fishing for recreation.
rubricZh: recreation 表示休閒（例如 for recreation 等）
「喜歡去釣魚」可寫，例如 likes to go fishing、enjoys fishing 等
